title: Qwen3.5-9B via Ollama, DGX Spark
slug_note: Ollama's Q4_K_M 9B lane in one command: 37.4 tok/s at the default 4K context, 1.1 GiB resident.

variation.quant_detail: Ollama's `qwen3.5:9b` tag = Q4_K_M (read with `ollama show` on our DGX Spark, 2026-11-16)
variation.revision_note: Ollama model ID shown by `ollama ps` on the Spark when measured (2026-11-16)

engine.config: Ollama default tag; the 2b/4b/9b tags sit under Ollama's 24 GiB threshold, so the server ran with OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=4096 to reproduce that default choice

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-11-16): 6.3 GB resident on the GPU (nvidia-smi, cell's own llama-server, weights + KV at num_ctx 4096); tag file 5.6 GB.

steps.text: Install Ollama (see Step 0 in Quick start).

measurements.method: openai_bench (SR-344 short_bench.py): streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; summarise neutral filler (631-token prompt, 256 output tokens)

openai_bench (SR-344 short_bench.py): streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; write an LRU cache module with tests (37-token prompt, 512 output tokens)

openai_bench (SR-344 short_bench.py): streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; write a 400-word essay (31-token prompt, 512 output tokens)

openai_bench (SR-344 short_bench.py): streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; time to first streamed token on the ~630-token summarise prompt

nvidia-smi per-process GPU allocation for the cell's own server during the bench (weights + KV at Ollama's default context for this size class (2.4-5.6 GB tag under Ollama's 24 GiB threshold -> 4096)); Ollama 0.40.10 built-in llama.cpp runner, num_ctx 4096

caveats: Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-11-16): `ollama run qwen3.5:9b` answered the one-word check after 8.1 s; functional check passed.

DGX Spark lab run 2026-11-16 19:40-19:47 (gpu.lock held; during-bench GPU apps = an idle 26 GB stage server + the cell's own Ollama server, no foreign load; accepted by replication against the 12:45 run - per-shape medians within 2.6%).
The tag's context is Ollama's default for its size class (4096 tokens). `ollama show` lists the full 262144 capability; raise num_ctx and memory grows with it.
